summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 6 years of experience in architecting and delivering full-
stack solutions. Proven ability to lead projects focused on application modernization
(React to TypeScript conversion), performance optimization, and implementing robust
test automation strategies. Combines technical expertise in Java and React with deep
knowledge of DevOps, including containerization and orchestration, to enhance team
productivity and ensure seamless, high-quality product delivery.

bullets: Project: AI-Powered Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Portal Project Description: Engineered a full-stack recruitment platform featuring an AI/ML- driven resume parser to automate candidate data extraction and streamline the "Easy Apply" process. Developed a comprehensive Admin & HR Dashboard to manage job postings, track applications, and perform bulk candidate data uploads for large-scale hiring. Built an automated email notification system to alert enrolled candidates of new openings, significantly increasing applicant engagement. The system enhances HR efficiency by centralizing candidate management and providing real-time analytics on job availability. Technologies: Next.js, Express, MongoDB, Ant Design, Tailwind CSS.
Development: Building a high-performance web platform for renewable energy services, utilizing Next.js for SEO-friendly rendering and Tailwind CSS for responsive UI.
Backend: Architected a scalable REST API using Express and MongoDB to manage dynamic project data and user inquiries.
AI/ML Integration: Automated data entry by extracting key details from uploaded resumes.
Bulk Processing: Developed tools for HR to upload and manage high- volume candidate datasets via Excel/CSV integration.
Automated Communication: Integrated SMTP/Email services for automated user engagement and status updates.

Project Description: Architected a full-stack automation platform at Tech Mahindra to manage and monitor large-scale router configurations via Camunda BPA. Designed a React frontend for bulk configuration updates, significantly reducing manual deployment errors across the network. Integrated Vitria for continuous real-time log monitoring and built custom Python scripts for automated incident detection. Engineered a seamless ServiceNow integration to trigger instant ticketing and team notifications upon detecting router failures. Technologies: React, Camunda (BPA), Python, Vitria, ServiceNow API, REST APIs

Automated Network Orchestration: Engineered a Business Process Automation (BPA) workflow using Camunda to automate complex configuration updates for network routers, reducing manual configuration errors and deployment time.
User-Centric Configuration Interface: Developed a React front-end application that allows administrators to input and validate router data before pushing updates to the automated pipeline.
Proactive Incident Monitoring: Integrated the Vitria monitoring tool with custom automation scripts to perform real-time log analysis and identify system failures.

Automated Incident Management: Streamlined support workflows by programmatically generating ServiceNow tickets upon failure detection, ensuring immediate team notification and faster MTTR (Mean Time To Repair).
Utilized the React.js library to create a dynamic UI with form functionality, enabling data submission and retrieval through REST API calls.
Designed and implemented interactive forms using React.js, handling all API- based communication for data submission and retrieval.
Developed a Rapid Infrastructure Automation (RIA) application with a user- friendly workflow to streamline and automate bare-metal provisioning and OS deployment through the MAAS API.
Managed the end-to-end incident lifecycle from proactive detection in Vitria logs to resolution and closure, acting as a key operations team member.
Automated critical network management tasks using Business Process Automation (BPA) tools, standardizing workflows for onboarding and decommissioning routers.
Role: UI Developer & Backend Integration Engineer
